fieldValues.title: An issue whose GitHub parent is an epic outside the roadmap fails the epic check, though its body names the right epic
fieldValues.summary: srs#236 (P0) was a sub-issue of muDemocracy.org#133 (Epic 14), which reaches no roadmap epic, so clerk flow showed '✗ epic' and builders skipped it on 10-29 and 10-30. A GitHub issue takes one parent, so it could not also sit under semanticops.com#31, the epic that implements its remedy (34e4af7c). Moved to #31 on 2026-10-30.
evidence: clerk flow --chain srs#236 before and after, 2026-10-30
GitHub sub-issues API: 'Sub issue may only have one parent'
fieldValues.body: Epics from the older programme (Epic 14 and siblings) still hold children that the new flow cannot see. A remedy would make each old epic a child of the roadmap epic that answers its problem, or move its children.
